title: Bismillah
body:
Bismillah
Bismillahi noor e khuda

Bismillahi ayn ul yaqeen
yab na ameerul mo'mineen..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan....
Aye yaare mann, aye yaare mann

aye sayyedo sardaar e mann

ali...ali...ali...ali....

ali...ali...ali...ali....
